energy_path.stage: Pressure enters: a demand, deadline, or standard set by someone else
energy_path.mechanism: The year stem Yi acts as Seven Killings to your Ji earth day master. External demands reach you directly and early — they arrive through the front door of the chart, not filtered through allies or contracts. Because the demand is real and specific, it gives your strong self something to push against.

energy_path.stage: Buffering: the demand is converted into method instead of stress
energy_path.mechanism: Direct Resource carries solid weight, fed by hidden Bing fire in both Si branches. When the demand lands, this layer converts it into steps and structure before it hits you raw. That is why you can sit with a hard requirement longer than most: it becomes a plan, not a weight on your chest.

energy_path.stage: Output: the demand is answered with finished craft
energy_path.mechanism: Eating God is the joint-heaviest force — the month stem Xin, plus hidden Xin in the day branch You and the year branch Chou. On a strong Ji earth self, output is the healthy release: making the thing literally drains excess load off you. This is the segment where you gain the most per unit of effort.

energy_path.stage: Recognition loops back as more demand, not as return
energy_path.mechanism: Direct Wealth carries zero weight and water, the element that carries Wealth for you, is absent from all visible characters. So a strong delivery produces no mechanism that converts it into rate, title, or credit. What flows back instead is a larger request from the same source — the recognition re-enters the loop at the pressure stage, which tightens it.

energy_path.stage: Peer mode absorbs the surplus instead of routing it upward
energy_path.mechanism: Companion ties Eating God for heaviest weight — the hour stem Ji mirrors you, hidden Ji sits in Chou, hidden Wu earth in both Si branches. Your operating default is to do it yourself or split it evenly. Direct Officer at zero means the formal-authority channel is empty: the vertical route where work is priced and promoted never gets exercised, so energy that should exit as negotiation exits as more labor instead.

leverage.point: The pressure-to-craft segment: one clear demand in, one finished object out
leverage.input: A specific, hard requirement with a real deadline — the kind others push back on
leverage.output: A working, finished piece delivered faster and cleaner than the brief warranted, plus a genuine drop in your internal load
leverage.why: Two heavy gods sit next to each other on a strong day master: Seven Killings supplies the push, Direct Resource converts it into method, and the heaviest force — Eating God — discharges it as craft. This chain is fully wired in the visible characters, so the loss per conversion is minimal. Your leverage is wasted anywhere else: the same effort spent on positioning, politicking, or self-promotion runs through channels that carry almost nothing in this chart — Direct Officer empty, Rob Wealth thin, Indirect Wealth nearly absent. One unit of input into craft moves more visible output than one unit into visibility itself.

vulnerability.point: The return end of the loop: work converts into demand, not into reward
vulnerability.condition: The structure grinds itself down when the counterparty controls both the demand and the price — typically a large hierarchy where terms are set two levels above you and your finished output disappears into someone else's report
vulnerability.mechanism: Seven Killings at five means pressure flows in through a wide opening, while Direct Wealth at zero and absent water mean the return opening is closed. Each cycle, Direct Resource buffers you just enough to absorb the next hit, Eating God spends itself servicing the request, and the finished object is the only sentence you speak — so the counterparty learns that handing you more works, and the inflow grows while the outflow-as-reward stays at zero. The drain runs precisely through the thing you are praised for.
vulnerability.self_check: After each delivery, ask three questions and write the answers down: what rate, title, or named credit did this produce for me; who besides the requester saw my name on it; and did the next request from the same source arrive with better terms or just more scope. If the three answers keep coming back as nothing, nobody, and more scope, the loop is running at a loss and needs the upgrade path below — not more effort inside it.

upgrade_path.phase: Phase 1: name the exit of every loop
upgrade_path.entry_condition: You have delivered at least one piece of work you consider excellent and received nothing back but a larger request — and you have noticed this inside a single episode rather than in retrospect
upgrade_path.work: Before accepting any new demand, write down what you get beyond the work being done: a rate, a title, a named credit, a decision-maker who sees your name. Treat a written 'nothing' as a reason to negotiate, not a reason to refuse. You are building, by hand, the return channel the chart does not provide — Direct Wealth at zero is structure, not verdict; a channel built by behavior still carries flow.
upgrade_path.done_signal: You can state, without discomfort, the price and the credit of your current work in one sentence — and at least one recent delivery carries your name somewhere a decision-maker can see it.

upgrade_path.phase: Phase 2: exercise the vertical channel in small doses
upgrade_path.entry_condition: Phase 1 is stable — terms are written before acceptance on most work, and 'good work speaks for itself' no longer feels like a reason to stay silent
upgrade_path.work: Your heaviest force, Companion, runs horizontally and will not do this for you, so treat upward negotiation as a practiced skill with reps, not an expression of character: one conversation per month where you present finished craft directly to the person who controls budget or title. Direct Officer is empty in the wiring, which means the first reps will feel foreign — that is absence of practice, not absence of capacity. Pair each rep with a peer from your circle, because Companion is your natural support structure; use it to enter the room rather than to avoid the room.
upgrade_path.done_signal: At least one rate, title, or scope decision has changed because you asked for it — not because someone offered. The room where your work is priced no longer feels like someone else's territory.

upgrade_path.phase: Phase 3: route some craft to your own name
upgrade_path.entry_condition: Phase 2 has produced at least one self-initiated win, and the water-branch decades are approaching or underway — the ten years starting around age forty-two run a water branch, and the ten years after that run another; the element that carries Wealth for you finally flows into the structure in those stretches
upgrade_path.work: In these decades, terms-and-price conversations run with less internal friction, so direct a fixed share of your Eating God output — the heaviest, most reliable engine you have — into projects that bank under your own name rather than a requester's. The mechanism to respect: your craft converts effort into finished objects at the highest rate in the chart; the upgrade is not making more objects but changing whose account the object lands in.
upgrade_path.done_signal: A meaningful share of your finished work generates return — income, reputation, or standing — that accrues to you by default, without a separate negotiation each time. The loop closes at reward instead of at the next demand.
